about: Frozen agriculture question set, same method as demo_questions.json. Written and verified against the extracted text of ingest/incoming/agriculture BEFORE any agriculture retrieval code existed (2026-10-04). A question counts as retrieved when every probe appears in the top-k chunks (whitespace removed, case-insensitive). 'dev' is fairly formal and is used while iterating. 'heldout' is casual farmer phrasing and is run only at the end; it must not drive any decision. 'dev_casual' (added the same day, after dev had been run, before heldout was ever run) is casual phrasing on topics and wordings unlike heldout, so HyDE -- whose value is on casual wording -- can be tuned without touching heldout. 'heldout' was run once on 2026-10-04 with the round-1 pipeline (69%; 50% without HyDE) and its misses were read, so it is no longer clean. 'heldout2' was written after that and BEFORE the round-2 changes (abbreviation glossary, HyDE v3); it is the clean test for them. 'heldout3' (14, casual) was written on 2026-10-04 before the router and the reranking / fusion experiments of that day; it is the clean test for them. 'final' (14) was written on 2026-10-04 after the baseline run and BEFORE any of that day's retrieval experiments, in deliberately mixed styles (Telugu-English, typos, long stories, two-word queries). It is run only twice: baseline and the chosen configuration.
